matches.quote: The RB-mixed state therefore persists only while non-zero gate voltages are held inside the bistable window. That is weaker than the usual meaning of non-volatility in memory
Fig. 3a overlays blue contours from a different contact configuration on data from the main configuration. Mark them clearly as such, or show them on their own map.
Reproducibility across devices and contacts is unclear from the main text... Switching occurs only in part of device A (Extended Data Fig. 4)
The "global shift" invoked to recover ABAB/ABCA is asserted, not demonstrated... Characterize device A itself, after fabrication... Raman 2D-band mapping... and KPFM
The claim... should be tempered or made more precise... State what is new: switching driven by a stacking change.
The theory comparison (Fig. 3b) is presented as quantitative ("agree well")... Give a quantitative measure of agreement, such as the ΔU values along each experimental contour
The stacking identity of the domains... is not established... The 22 mV KPFM contrast... could instead be a polarization contrast.
The KPFM work-function difference used in the theory is measured... on a sample on SiO2 or on a stamp. Comment on how well this ΔΦ transfers
All main-text data come from device A... the text does not say whether device B also shows the gate-driven structural switching and the on/off AHE.
There is no direct evidence that the resistance bistability is a stacking transition... Other explanations not yet excluded: ... electronic (rather than structural) bistability
"First-order quantum phase transition" (p. 2) is not an accurate description... "Gate-driven first-order structural transition" would be more accurate.
Discuss how a modest rhombohedral area fraction can produce an AHE larger than that of a pure rhombohedral device.
Report the switching thresholds versus sweep rate and temperature.

notes: The review did not have access to the Extended Data figures or Supplementary Information, so concerns tied to specific panels there (C6 on ED Fig. 2c/d values, C10 on ED Fig. 9 panel, C11 on Fig. S1, C16 on ED Fig. 7h) could only be raised partly or not at all; however, P16 inferred the core C2 issue with device B directly from the main text. P9 and P18 are bare section headers extracted as points.
